notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a SECOND, independent synthetic application (Coastal Imaging Solutions, Inc.) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C24126Q0731 -- built to add SFT/eval training data with deliberately different failure and compliance shapes from the original application (Meridian Medical Systems, LLC).

Error-shape diversity versus the original: quote_signed_and_dated, far_52_212_3_reps_and_certs, product_chart_full_pricing's overall completeness route, brand_name_no_substitutes, shipping_cost_handling, and single_best_price_quote are mostly inverted from the original's failure pattern to compliant, while two new failures are introduced in different places (an unpriced UPS line item; an explicit burner-drive substitution) and a new warranty-duration contradiction (3-year base vs 2-year component) replaces the original's pricing-option contradiction.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: Offeror must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM).
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine SAM registration status cannot be confirmed from application text.

verdicts.description: Offeror must be certified/verified as an SD/VOSB in the SBA SBS VIP (Veteran Information Pages) VetCert.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine SDVOSB VIP-listing status cannot be confirmed from application text.

verdicts.description: Offeror must actually meet the Limitations on Subcontracting (LOS) requirements in the LOS clauses.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- actual LOS compliance cannot be confirmed from the assertion alone.

verdicts.description: Offeror must assert compliance with the LOS clauses in the email accompanying the quote.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly asserts compliance with the LOS clauses in the email.

evidence.quote:
We confirm compliance with the Limitations on Subcontracting clauses
applicable to this solicitation.

verdicts.description: Quoter must enter its Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), annotated as such, in the name-and-address block on the cover page of the quote.
verdicts.rationale: UEI is explicitly entered and annotated as such.

verdicts.description: If applicable, the quoter must also enter its Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) indicator in the name-and-address block on the cover page of the quote.
verdicts.rationale: Application never mentions an EFT indicator at all, so it is unconfirmed whether one applies and was omitted, or none applies.

verdicts.description: The quote submitted to the government office must be signed and dated.
verdicts.rationale: Application is signed by name and includes an explicit date.

evidence.quote:
Renata Ferro
Contracts Manager
Coastal Imaging Solutions, Inc.
Date: 09/10/2026

verdicts.description: The UEI must already exist in SAM at the time of competition, not be newly registered during the solicitation period.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- whether the UEI pre-existed in SAM at time of competition cannot be confirmed from the application text alone.

verdicts.description: The quote must show the solicitation number.
verdicts.rationale: Solicitation number is stated in the subject line.

evidence.quote:
Subject: Quote for Solicitation 36C24126Q0731 P0003 - Sorna Vertex 25ei
Platform/CD Burner

verdicts.description: The quote must show the time specified in the solicitation for receipt of quotations.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly states the 11:00 AM EDT on 09/18/26 receipt time.

evidence.quote:
We acknowledge the time specified
in the solicitation for receipt of quotations as 11:00 AM EDT on
09/18/26.

verdicts.description: The quote must show the name, address, and telephone number of the quoter.
verdicts.rationale: Name, address, and telephone number are all provided.

evidence.quote:
Coastal Imaging Solutions, Inc.
410 Harbor Commerce Way
New Bedford, MA 02740
Telephone: (508) 555-0193

verdicts.description: The quote must show a technical description of the items being quoted in sufficient detail to evaluate compliance with the solicitation's requirements.
verdicts.rationale: Application describes the quoted platform, software, and configuration in sufficient detail.

evidence.quote:
Technical description of items quoted: We are quoting the Sorna Vertex
25ei Platform with integrated Sorna CD Burner, matching the brand and
model specified in the Product Chart

verdicts.description: The quote must show the terms of any express warranty.
verdicts.rationale: Application states the base configuration carries a 3-year warranty, but then states the burner drive specifically carries only a 2-year warranty under the manufacturer's schedule -- the two stated warranty durations for the same overall system conflict without reconciling which governs.

evidence.quote:
coverage is limited to a
2-year parts-and-labor warranty per the manufacturer's component
schedule.

verdicts.description: The quote must show price and any discount terms.
verdicts.rationale: Application states Net 30 payment terms and a 1% early-payment discount.

evidence.quote:
Net 30 days from invoice date. A 1% discount
applies if paid within 10 days.

verdicts.description: The quote must show a remit-to address, if different from the mailing address.
verdicts.rationale: Application provides an explicit remit-to address different from the mailing address.

verdicts.description: Quote must include a completed copy of the representations and certifications under FAR 52.212-3.
verdicts.rationale: Application states a completed copy of the FAR 52.212-3 representations and certifications is attached to the email as Exhibit A.

evidence.quote:
a completed copy of these representations is attached to this
email as Exhibit A.

verdicts.description: Quote must acknowledge receipt of amendments to the request for quotation.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly states no amendments had been issued, addressing the requirement directly.

evidence.quote:
No amendments to this solicitation had been issued as of the date of
this quote.

verdicts.description: Quote must include one of the two prescribed statements about the solicitation's terms and conditions -- full acceptance without modification, or acceptance with listed exceptions and their rationale.
verdicts.rationale: Application includes the prescribed acceptance statement about the solicitation's terms and conditions.

evidence.quote:
The terms and conditions in the solicitation are
acceptable to be included in the award document without modification,
deletion, or addition.

verdicts.description: Quote must enter pricing for every line item listed in the Product Chart.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly leaves the UPS 1KVA - Tower line item unpriced, pending vendor confirmation, rather than entering pricing for every line item.

evidence.quote:
UPS 1KVA - Tower, Qty 1, pricing TBD pending vendor confirmation of
current unit cost.

verdicts.description: Quote must be for the Sorna Vertex 25ei Platform/CD Burner by brand name; no substitute or equivalent products may be offered.
verdicts.rationale: Application proposes substituting a compatible burner drive from an alternate manufacturer for the disc-burner component, rather than quoting the named brand exclusively as required.

evidence.quote:
we propose to substitute a
compatible high-speed burner drive from an alternate manufacturer,
which meets or exceeds the write-speed and reliability specifications
of the drive bundled with the named brand-name unit.

verdicts.description: If shipping does not reach $250.00, its cost must be rolled into the Vertex 25ei/CD Burner line-item price rather than billed separately.
verdicts.rationale: Application states shipping of $140.00 (below the $250.00 threshold) is rolled into the Vertex 25ei/CD Burner unit price rather than billed as a separate line item, matching the requirement.

evidence.quote:
this unit price includes $140.00 of
shipping cost, rolled in because shipping does not reach $250.00

verdicts.description: Quoters are requested to submit one quote presenting their best price, rather than multiple alternative quotes.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly presents a single best and final price with no alternate configurations offered.

evidence.quote:
This quote presents our single best and final price; we are not
offering any alternate configurations.

verdicts.description: Quote must be emailed to the government POC and received no later than 11:00 AM EDT on 09/18/26.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- concerns the process of submission (channel and timing), not application content.
